violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (trash with pans on top). A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was ( 0 ) parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be (200-400 ) ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Working containers of (dry ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was (0 ) parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for (quaternary ) sanitizer is (200-400 ) ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -bakers racks -prep area(butcher block) -donuts display case New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The floors throughout the facility including under equipment and ceiling in kitchen(dust) have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/11/2024

An employee was observed washing their hands at the 3 bay sink. Food employees shall clean their hands in a designated hand-washing sink and not in a food preparation, mop, or ware-washing sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2024

An employee did not use soap while washing his/her hands. Food employees must use a cleaning compound (soap) as part of hand cleaning procedures. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2024

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2024

The presence of insects is not controlled as evidenced by dead insects in 2 light panels which were cleaned since last inspection. PIC stated there is an issue with bees. Reliable Pest Control Services weekly. Last date of service 10/1/2024 The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
The splash guard at the handsink in the kitchen was not in good repair, with a hole in the center of it. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/11/2024
No person in charge was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2024

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/11/2024

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2024

Spic & Span spray bottle was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2024
The splash guard at the kitchen hand sink was not in good repair, with a hole in the center of it. New Violation. Correct By: 10/11/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of dry ingredient bins, refrigerator, and rolling cart have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2024
The floors have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2024

The ceiling light panels in the kitchen have an accumulation of dead insects and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/11/2024
